MyEsims.title: My eSIMs
MyEsims.description: Your installed and purchased eSIMs will appear here.
MyEsims.failed: We couldn't issue this eSIM. Contact support via the Telegram bot.
MyEsims.guideDescription: Use Install eSIM, or scan the QR code if the button does not open setup.
MyEsims.guideIos1: Tap Install eSIM and confirm when your iPhone asks to add the cellular plan.
MyEsims.guideIos2: Keep this screen open until setup finishes.
MyEsims.guideIos3: If nothing happens, go to Settings → Cellular → Add eSIM and scan the QR code.
MyEsims.guideAndroid1: Tap Install eSIM and allow the eSIM to be added.
MyEsims.guideAndroid2: Follow the prompts until the plan shows as installed.
MyEsims.guideAndroid3: If nothing happens, go to Settings → Network & internet → SIMs → Add eSIM and scan the QR code.

Help.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about eSIM, device compatibility, fees, and what Simverse plans include.
Help.title: Help
Help.intro: Answers to the questions we hear most about eSIM.
Help.whatIsEsim: An eSIM is a digital SIM built into your phone. You install a data plan with a QR code or a tap — no plastic card to insert or swap.
Help.deviceSupportTitle: How do I know if my phone supports eSIM?
Help.deviceSupport: Open the phone app and dial *#06#. If an EID (eSIM identifier) appears, your device supports eSIM. You can also look in Settings for an “Add eSIM” option. The phone must be unlocked from its original carrier.
Help.feesTitle: Are there hidden or extra fees?
Help.fees: No. The price shown at checkout is what you pay. We do not add activation, roaming, or other hidden charges.
Help.callsAndSmsTitle: Can I receive calls and SMS on the eSIM?
Help.callsAndSms: Our eSIMs are data-only. They do not receive calls or SMS, including one-time verification codes. Keep your regular SIM for voice and text.
